hero.headline: In Her Memory. For Her People.
hero.subtext: Lagni Devi Memorial Foundation — Empowering communities through education, service, and remembrance.

about.headline: Beyond remembrance, towards real change.
about.body: Lagni Devi Memorial Foundation is a grassroots non-profit organisation established in 2020 to honour the life and legacy of Smt. Lagni Devi, who lived from 1945 to 2019. Born in a small village in Uttar Pradesh, Smt. Lagni Devi dedicated her life to community welfare, teaching children at home and empowering rural women towards self-employment despite having very limited resources. Following her passing, her family and community members founded the organisation to keep her legacy of compassion and service alive under the guiding principles of "Remembering, Honouring, and Serving."

stories.headline: Stories of change, close to the ground.
stories.priya: Priya Yadav from Azamgarh secured a job in Lucknow and began supporting her family after completing the free computer course.
stories.rahul: Rahul Kumar from Mau was able to pass his Class 10 board exams with distinction instead of dropping out, allowing him to pursue college.
stories.sunita: Sunita Devi from Ballia established her own tailoring shop, achieving financial independence.
stories.arif: Mohammed Arif's father received timely medical treatment after doctors identified a heart condition during a free village health camp.
stories.kavita: In Gorakhpur, Kavita Singh's daughter secured a stable job following the Spoken English course.
stories.dinesh: Dinesh Patel's village in Jaunpur received crucial aid during a drought.
